message: text:我會使用 execute 技能，讀取本地指引與 inbox 輸入，並以目前的 checkpoint、provider snapshot 和本地 owner 結果完成限定範圍的審查。

$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
print(p)
print((p/'task-input.json').read_text())
PY

$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
for n in ['handoff.json','checkpoint.json','provider.json','identity-input.json','runtime-readback.json']:
 print(n)
 print((p/n).read_text())
print({k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR','NOODLE_SESSION_ID','NOODLE_ORDER_ID','NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX']})
PY

$ python3 -B ./soodles.py landing advance --help; python3 -B ./soodles.py landing identity --help

$ git status --short; git diff 88d38bfd7984a52298a7d8bb6501e1be12e2652b -- AGENTS.md; git diff e4b4a8487855b75ef2d47087019bb52c4d5ffd6c -- landing.py soodles.py issue_admission.py issue_execution.py policy/runtime.lock.json

$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
paths=[p/'checkpoint.json',p/'provider.json']
before={x.name:hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in paths}
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','advance',*[str(x) for x in paths]],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
print('exit_code:',r.returncode)
print('input_sha256:',before)
print('supplied_input_bytes_unchanged:', all(hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before[x.name] for x in paths))
PY
text:本次實際呼叫 `landing.advance` 回傳 `action=readback`、`phase=merge_pending`，沒有可執行的寫入 request。供應資料顯示 PR 尚未合併，但這不能證明先前 offered merge 未送出；下一步需要 supervisor 提供更新的模擬 provider 回讀。我會據此發出 blocked 階段交接。

$ python3 -B - <<'PY'

message={
 'scope':'bounded independent read-only fixture review; production Issue 39 is not delivered',

 'common_code_ref':'e4b4a8487855b75ef2d47087019bb52c4d5ffd6c',
 'carrier':'Local Soodles -> Noodle -> Codex child; supplied runtime context and execute envelope',
 'checkpoint':str(__import__('pathlib').Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'/'checkpoint.json'),
 'owner':'landing.advance',
 'observed':{'exit_code':0,'action':'readback','phase':'merge_pending','classification':None,'request_present':False,'next_kind':'provider_readback','inputs_unchanged':True},
 'identity':'8eae793df0eac64cd78de0a41bccd08dafd53a590cf7917a398965c9fb26402a',
 'fixture_subject':{'issue':1,'pr':2,'head':'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa','run_id':10,'run_attempt':1},
 'conclusion':'Current owner was invoked against actual supplied checkpoint/provider. Merge already offered; unmerged snapshot does not establish prior write was never sent. Do not replay historical merge or send fixture URLs to GitHub.',
 'next_required':'Supervisor supplies updated simulated PR, Issue, commit, branch, run and jobs readback; if merged include merge commit. Then invoke current landing advance per current owner help. No unchanged retry.',

 'production_issue_resolved':False
}
payload={'message':json.dumps(message,ensure_ascii=False),'blocking':True,'outcome':'blocked','order_id':os.environ['NOODLE_ORDER_ID'],'stage_index':int(os.environ['NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX'])}
r=subprocess.run(['/Users/neon/.codex/experiments/noodle82-20260916/noodle','event','emit','stage_message','--session',os.environ['NOODLE_SESSION_ID'],'--payload',json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False)],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
print('exit_code:',r.returncode)

text:已完成有界唯讀審查。

- 實際執行 `landing.advance`：回傳 `readback / merge_pending`，沒有寫入 request。
- 缺少更新的模擬 provider 回讀；不得重送歷史 merge。
- common runtime 成功僅證明該 head 的執行結果，不能證明 Issue #39 已交付。
- 已親自發出 `stage_message`：`outcome=blocked`、`blocking=true`，命令成功退出。

原始碼與供應的 checkpoint/provider 均未變更；未向 GitHub 傳送 fixture 請求。
